subject.title: /stop abort leaves streaming card in idle state, blocking subsequent messages (replies=0)

question: Should this issue require a live Feishu/CardKit trace before choosing the shared reply-operation versus Feishu streaming-card fix boundary?
rationale: Source inspection shows a plausible shared zero-reply abort path and a plausible Feishu CardKit settlement path, but the exact production failure depends on live Feishu streaming-card state that this read-only review could not exercise.

options.title: Require Live Feishu Trace
options.body: Keep this routed to a Feishu-capable maintainer until a redacted current-main trace shows session key, reply-operation state, `queuedFinal`, counts, and CardKit close/discard behavior after `/stop`.

options.title: Queue Source-Level Repair
options.body: Allow an automated fix from source evidence, accepting the risk that it may patch only the shared abort path or only the Feishu card path without proving the live failure boundary.

options.title: Defer To Adjacent Issues
options.body: Treat the issue as covered by broader Feishu streaming or `replies=0` investigations, preserving this report only as linked evidence.

recommendation.title: Require Live Feishu Trace
recommendation.body: Keep this routed to a Feishu-capable maintainer until a redacted current-main trace shows session key, reply-operation state, `queuedFinal`, counts, and CardKit close/discard behavior after `/stop`.
